description: From a bug report or a written contract, can a shipped coding agent make a change to nb, a .NET codebase of about 13,000 lines it cannot read whole? Five tasks report a defect planted in nb at a pinned revision and one asks for a feature; hidden acceptance says whether the change is right, and nb's own tests say whether anything else broke.

arms.description: Qwen Code on the local model: the free shakedown arm

acceptance.description: the task's hidden acceptance passes: the reported defect is gone, or, for a report of documented behaviour, no code was changed

suite-green.description: nb's own tests pass on the changed repository (a failing run is repeated once, since one of nb's tests depends on timing)

planted-present.description: the repository the agent was given held this task's planted defect

tests-untouched.description: no test nb already had was edited or deleted

named-cause.description: the closing message names the file that holds the defect (for a report of documented behaviour, the page that documents it)
